requirements.requirement: Integrate existing interfaces without replacing independent audit or duplicating verify state. Re-capture checks as evidence only.

HMA records its own result and leaves an existing PENDING criterion unchanged. No second verify controller or semantic auditor was introduced.

requirements.requirement: HMA alone generates packet, nonce and dispatch binding to exact current implementation, approved repository/base and observed target.
requirements.independent_checks: Try manual packet injection, other root/base, dirty drift, missing binding and stale core.
requirements.observation: HMA generates a 128-bit nonce and packet digest. Manual packet injection, first-packet clone/unbound cases, wrong base/root and wrong artifact controls refuse. A repository binding is an explicit one-time host step.

requirements.requirement: Receipt binds run, mode, completion, route including provider/effort, packet, launch target, report hash and nonce. Failed/missing/stale/other report grants nothing.
requirements.independent_checks: Try mismatched fields, old reports, duplicate imports, malformed/ambiguous JSON and Python-contract parity.
requirements.observation: Provider, effort, worker, model, completion, mode, exit, packet, target, report-file and nonce checks fail closed. Invalid/missing required fields, case variants, information separators, trailing JSON and invalid UTF-8 cannot approve. The external Python validator agrees on the auditor report matrix.

requirements.requirement: Review independence covers all unit implementations; final/disputed/high require provider/model family separation and isolated final acceptance.
requirements.independent_checks: Same worker/model/context; earlier contributor; final with FinalValidation false; independent control.
requirements.observation: The source checks all implementation contributions. Existing runtime tests exercise prior contributor and final-reason family separation. Normal and stronger isolation rules preserve the different-model/provider-family boundary.

requirements.requirement: Current review has short half-open validity; core changes, target drift, new pending packet and replay cannot reuse approval. Reservation generations deferred.
requirements.independent_checks: Boundary timestamps, old pass after newer failure/pending packet, staleness on core and live target.
requirements.observation: Auditor probes accept the issuance instant and one nanosecond before expiry. They refuse before issuance, at expiry and after expiry. Exactly one concurrent import succeeds. A new pending packet closes the old gate and snapshot; a current new report/snapshot restores it. Core and live target drift refuse.

requirements.requirement: Snapshots replace exact unit findings; nonapproval preserves BLOCK/WAIVABLE; empty clearing requires exact latest imported approval; no global ID collisions.
requirements.independent_checks: Downgrades, omission, stale snapshots, slash owners, migrated unprefixed/unowned records and waivers.
requirements.observation: Failed and escalating snapshots retain same-ID and omitted BLOCK/WAIVABLE findings. Fresh approval clears only the exact owner. Legacy own/unowned findings and active waiver scopes remain readable. Imported slash IDs and duplicate global IDs are refused.

requirements.requirement: Imported unsupported citations/severity do not create blockers; imports never credit criteria. Positive mapping/credit deferred unchanged.
requirements.independent_checks: Fake kernel/budget links; failed criteria; inspect all write paths.
requirements.observation: Unsupported kernel/budget citations and severity alone remain ADVISORY. A pass carrying a citation escalates. Neither imported report snapshots nor loop evidence writes criterion credit. Positive reproduced disposition/credit remains Gate D.

requirements.requirement: Check execution refuses terminal/missing/stale route or wrong repository before launch; host/core locks protect check through append; capture uses argv without shell/forbidden ops and retains inspectable output.
requirements.independent_checks: Closed-run marker, concurrent core append, root/base drift, shell/wrapper/script aliases, mutating check, corrupt artifact residue, truncation.
requirements.observation: Missing/terminal runs and wrong root/base/journal repository refuse before argv. The core lock is held inside the check. Shell/script/interpreter/wrapper entry points and forbidden executable aliases refuse. Stdout/stderr, a nonzero exit, truncation, framed digest, intact reuse and corrupt-residue refusal were reproduced.

requirements.requirement: Existing hash chains and legacy records remain readable with no-flag semantics; migration is visible and cannot reopen manual review after packet enforcement.
requirements.independent_checks: Legacy serialization/read/projection, enforcement label, manual overrides after failed import.
requirements.observation: Baseline-written core and six host records remain readable. Status exposes legacy_manual; packet migration blocks later manual reviews. Two new write results break the documented human-facing result contract (J10-01 and J10-02). The binding prerequisite is documented in scope §4c, so Phase 1 J10-03 is withdrawn.

requirements.source: Original §5 Gate C and §6; scope C4
requirements.requirement: Reproducible failure -> remediation -> fresh review fixtures and Gate B regression checks pass.
requirements.independent_checks: go test ./..., go vet ./..., go test -race ./..., scripts/dogfood/host-dogfood.sh and own negative controls.
requirements.observation: The unmodified copied tree passes go test, go vet, go test -race, and synthetic host dogfood (17 checks). Auditor safety negative controls pass separately. Two added presentation assertions fail reproducibly; these failures are retained as findings, not converted into passing tests.

requirements.requirement: Each deferred original requirement has preserved Gate D exit tests and no Gate C authority, criterion or closure claim depends on it.
requirements.independent_checks: Trace reservation, generation, reconciliation, hook, full packet, positive credit and disposition rows; inspect documentation claims.
requirements.observation: Accepted scope §0.1 preserves the deferred requirement rows and original design proof matrix. Scope §4b/§4c records current no-shell and repository-binding limits. TODO leaves reservations and Gate C independent audit/commit open. Imports grant neither launch authority, positive criterion credit, nor closure.

findings.title: bind-repository returns an empty next action
findings.diagnosis: The successful bind-repository handler encodes hostResultFor directly. That helper does not set NextAction. The real binary returns next_action:"", contrary to architecture §18. The binding succeeds; no authority bypass was observed.

evidence.observation: Successful repository_binding record has review_enforcement:"legacy_manual" and next_action:"".
The handler returns hostResultFor without assigning NextAction.
TestAuditor10jPresentationContract/bind-repository-next-action fails against the compiled current binary.

fix.action: Assign one explicit next action after successful repository binding before encoding the result. Define that action in the command contract; use NOTHING only if stopping is the intended action.
fix.why: Every gate result must tell the host one next action under architecture §18.

verification.method: Run the real bind-repository binary command and parse its JSON result; retain wrong-identity/rebinding refusals.
verification.expected: Successful output has one documented nonempty next_action. Refused calls append nothing.

fix.tradeoffs: Additive presentation change. Keep dispatch_allowed false and do not imply stage or launch approval.
fix.alternative: Teach hostResultFor to accept a required action parameter. This has a wider call-site cost.

findings.title: loop-evidence omits the review enforcement label
findings.diagnosis: loop-evidence builds hostResult directly and never fills ReviewEnforcement. Its successful JSON omits review_enforcement. task14 states that every write result reports legacy_manual or packet_import. host show --mode remains correct, so this is a result-contract gap, not an observed enforcement bypass.

evidence.observation: Every write result and host show --mode must report review_enforcement.
The result literal does not populate ReviewEnforcement.
The real binary records loop_evidence with next_action:EVIDENCE_RECORDED but no review_enforcement member.

fix.action: Fill ReviewEnforcement from the committed host history while the existing host lock is held, or construct the result after releasing locks through the shared result helper. Do not invoke its locking Load inside the host transaction.
fix.why: The result must disclose the same enforcement mode that the persisted run uses without creating a recursive-lock deadlock.

verification.method: Run loop-evidence on legacy_manual and packet_import runs with passing and failing recaptures. Compare each result with host show --mode under a timeout.
verification.expected: Every successful write reports the correct mode and one next action. Commands complete without deadlock; no criterion is credited.

fix.tradeoffs: No record schema or authority change. Avoid a second unlocked read if exact response-time mode matters.
fix.alternative: Build all host write results through one helper that accepts the already loaded committed history.

withdrawn_phase1_findings.title: The host contract omits the new required repository-binding step
withdrawn_phase1_findings.diagnosis: review-packet and loop-evidence now require a one-time repository binding. README.md and the normative task14 CLI/workflow do not name bind-repository, its payload, its prerequisite, or migration. An existing or unbound run following the published steps stops with HOST_REPOSITORY_BINDING_MISSING. The refusal is correct; the migration instructions are incomplete.

evidence.observation: The CLI list omits bind-repository. The imported-review section at line 133 and pilot steps at line 326 omit the binding prerequisite.
rg returned exit 1 with no matches for bind-repository, repository_binding or HOST_REPOSITORY_BINDING_MISSING across README, architecture and task14.
The first unbound packet refuses unchanged with HOST_REPOSITORY_BINDING_MISSING; a bound root rejects a clone with HOST_REVIEW_REPOSITORY_MISMATCH.

fix.action: Document hma host bind-repository and its host envelope plus repository_root/repository_identity payload in task14. Put the explicit one-time binding before review-packet or loop-evidence. Explain its match to core approvals, canonical root, immutable binding and safe legacy migration. Add the CLI entry in README if it lists these commands.
fix.why: The published host workflow must supply the newly required prerequisite without deriving repository identity from the review packet.

verification.method: Follow only the documented migration from a baseline legacy run; run the documented bind command, packet, import and snapshot. Repeat with no binding, wrong root/identity and a second binding.
verification.expected: The documented valid sequence works. All wrong/missing/rebinding cases retain named refusals and unchanged chains.
